parameters.query: SELECT ls.lead_id, l.phone, l.channel, ls.pending_booking_data, ls.payment_mode, ls.payment_preference FROM lead_state ls JOIN leads l ON ls.lead_id = l.id WHERE ls.flow_order_id = '{{ \.commerceOrder }}' LIMIT 1
UPDATE lead_state SET payment_status='paid', last_bot_action='payment_confirmed', updated_at=NOW() WHERE lead_id='{{ $json.lead_id }}'
